answer: Each epoch a witness set of 8 identities is sampled from the established pool, and a submission must reach at least half of them to settle at all. Because the draw comes from the vertex beacon after close, the sonnet panel cannot be pre-arranged, and the falcon record shows which witnesses responded. A farm holding 20 fresh keys hence pays for 20 identities yet owns no seat in the sample, so its answers stall while honest work settles. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
